description: An axe is a tiered tool that can quickly break wood and plant blocks, and a melee weapon with high attack damage but low attack speed .‌ [ JE only ] It has the special ability to perform crushing blows , which disable the use of a target's shield.
A brush is a tool used in archaeology to excavate suspicious sand and suspicious gravel for different items. Brushes also can be used on armadillos to get armadillo scutes .
A fishing rod is a tool that casts a bobber used to fish in water or to hook and pull mobs , items ,‌ [ JE only ] and some other entities toward the player.
A carrot on a stick is a tool that can be used to control saddled pigs .
A warped fungus on a stick is a tool that can be used to control saddled striders .
